item.title: Pleasant Plains girls' basketball wins third place in 2A
item.description: NORMAL, Ill. (WCIA) - Pleasant Plains girls' basketball finished its season with a win. The Cardinals beat Elgin-St. Edward 53-33 on Thursday night in the 2A third place game at Illinois State's CEFCU Arena. It's a same-day bounce back win for TJ Fraase's team after losing 48-40 to Breese Central in the semifinals Thursday afternoon. [...]
